text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity - dedicated-pool-us-west-2 GPU_UTILIZATION > 95% for 12m. Affected tenants: multiple reserved-tenants (incl. AcmeCorp). Please acknowledge and follow runbook 'dedicated-gpu-capacity'.

sara: ack. I'm oncall. seeing queue growth on the dedicated pool; throttles firing.

kai: looking at autoscaler logs now — previous scale-up attempts keep failing with quota error.

mari: customer-impact: AcmeCorp reports higher tail latency and 429s on their dedicated endpoint. CSM pinged (anna-csm).

sara: timeline: at ~1784202100 we saw a noisy neighbor blast with large batch inference; reserved GPUs all pinned to user slots. Autoscaler attempted 3x scale, got API errors from cloud.

ops-bot: Autoscaler event: scale_attempt {"attempt":3, "reason":"queue_length>500"} -> error: "InsufficientQuota: RequestedInstanceCount exceeds vGPU quota"

sara: copying relevant autoscaler snippet:

```
2026-02-14T21:03:12Z autoscaler controller: reconcile start
2026-02-14T21:03:15Z autoscaler: requested 8 new instances for pool dedicated-usw2
2026-02-14T21:03:15Z cloud-api: error InsufficientQuota: Quota exceeded (vGPU-core-hours)
2026-02-14T21:03:16Z autoscaler: mark scale_failed
```

devon: noisy neighbor pattern detected — one tenant submitted long >64k token requests with batch_size=128 across reserved allocation. Need immediate throttling per-tenant.

sara: agreed. I'm going to apply emergency per-tenant rate-limit and reduce default batch size on the pool. Doing step 1: enable tenant throttle for AcmeCorp.

```
# ephemeral admin command (audit logged)
redwood-cli pools throttle set --pool dedicated-usw2 --tenant acme --rps 4 --token-burst 200
```

sara: throttle applied. Monitoring queue.

kai: reducing global max_batch_size on pool to 16 to free slots.

```
redwood-cli pools config update --pool dedicated-usw2 --max-batch-size 16
```

mari: telling AcmeCorp we applied measures to reduce errors; CSM note: please provide ETA for full restore.

incident-bot: Notification posted to #customer-notifications: "We are actively mitigating elevated latency for AcmeCorp. Temporary throttling and batch-size adjustments applied. We'll update within 30m."

jordan: re: autoscaler quota error — who owns cloud quota request? I can fast-track an emergency quota increase if we get approval from finance; otherwise we need overflow plan.

sara: finance approval not instant. Plan B: move highest-impact reserved tenants to a burst shared pool (non-reserved) — that will cost us but restore customer-facing service.

kai: I can migrate the routing rule for AcmeCorp to shared-burst pool. Migration steps (live):
```
# dry-run first
redwood-cli tenants migrate --tenant acme --from-pool dedicated-usw2 --to-pool shared-burst --dry-run
# if looks good
redwood-cli tenants migrate --tenant acme --to-pool shared-burst --force
```

sara: prefer non-invasive first: keep throttle + smaller batch for 10m and watch queue. If queue doesn't subside, migrate.

ops-bot: queue_length: dedicated-usw2 = 420 -> 180 after throttle + batch change (5m). Throttles_count: 320.

mari: AcmeCorp still sees errors but reduced. CSM asked for rollback plan in case migration spikes erroring.

kai: logged a guardrail: if migration fails, we'll revert routing within 60s using traffic-shadowing to verify.

deploy-bot: Deploy event detected: template-change to pool config (max-batch-size=16) rolled out to 6/6 nodes. No failures.

sara: queue trending down but autoscaler still blocked on quota. I'll escalate to platform infra to request emergency capacity or temporary quota bump.

sara: paging platform infra: @devon can you raise emergency quota with cloud vendor? Tell them it's affecting paying enterprise tenant (AcmeCorp).

devon: on it. opening support case now. Case ID: CLOUD-87612. Estimated time to resolution unknown; support said "expedite" tag requested.

incident-bot: Support case CLOUD-87612 acknowledged. Updates will be posted here.

jordan: prepping handoff — my shift starts in 12m. Current action items for next oncall:
- continue monitoring queue & throttles
- complete tenant migration if queue stays >200 for 10m
- coordinate with devon for quota updates
- update customer comms if migrating

sara: handing off to jordan in 10m. I'll remain available for 30m as secondary. Noted outstanding: migration dry-run ok, queue=150 now.

anna-csm: AcmeCorp PM updated: appreciates quick communication, wants postmortem and whether dedicated SLAs were impacted. I'll coordinate for postmortem and credits.

ops-bot: metric snapshot attached: cpu_util 92%, gpu_util 97%, queue_latency_p95 1.4s -> 0.8s after measures.

jordan: ack takeover. I'll keep the thread active. If quota not resolved in 30m, I will initiate migration to shared-burst and notify CSM before cutover.

sara: thanks all. tagging incident channel for visibility :rotating_light: :handshake:

incident-bot: Incident status -> INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING.

# end of thread
